title: Save / Load with DataStores
summary: The canonical persistence loop: load on PlayerAdded (pcall + retries), hold session data in server memory, save on PlayerRemoving AND BindToClose, and use UpdateAsync for conflict-safe writes.

explanation.whatItIs: The save-system recipe that survives joins, leaves, and server shutdowns — with retries and conflict handling baked in.
explanation.whyItExists: DataStores are networked and rate-limited; naive Get/Set loses data under lag, crashes, and overlapping sessions.
whenToUse: Load once per player at join (retry loop), keep the data in a server table
Save on leave (PlayerRemoving) and on shutdown (BindToClose)
UpdateAsync for any write that might race (multiple servers, session locking)
Auto-save interval (e.g., every 60–120s) as a safety net
whenNotToUse: Saving every change instantly — batch to respect rate limits
Storing unsanitized/large blobs — keep data small and versioned
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
PlayerAdded ──▶ pcall load (retries) ──▶ session table[player] = data
   │
   ├─ gameplay mutates session table (fast, in-memory)
   │
PlayerRemoving ─▶ save (pcall)
BindToClose ─────▶ save everyone (shutdown grace)
Interval task ───▶ periodic save (safety net)

Writes: UpdateAsync("key", function(old) return merge(old) end)
```
tips: Version your data shape ({ version = 2, … }) for painless migrations
Session locking (a flag inside the data) prevents cross-server duplication exploits
commonMistakes: SetAsync on every stat change — rate limits eat your budget
No BindToClose — shutdown kills unsaved progress
Forgetting pcall — one DataStore hiccup breaks the handler
Loading twice (PlayerAdded races) and overwriting fresh session edits

examples.title: Complete save/load skeleton
examples.code:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData_v1")
local sessions = {}

local function load(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    for attempt = 1, 3 do
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
                if old and old.locked then
                    error("session locked")   -- someone else has it
                end
                return old or { version = 1, coins = 0 }
            end)
        end)
        if ok then
            sessions[player] = result
            return
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
    warn(`Failed to load data for {player.Name}`)
end

local function save(player)
    local data = sessions[player]
    if not data then return end
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        store:UpdateAsync(key, function()
            return data
        end)
    end)
    if not ok then warn(`Save failed for {player.Name}: {err}`) end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(load)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    save(player)
    sessions[player] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        save(player)
    end
end)
